hypothesis: The opt-in boundary-only DP row clearing preserves full native species-pair search outputs beyond the previously replicated 32-query kernel microbenchmarks and can reduce search-stage CPU/wall cost without an accuracy tradeoff.
controls: Compile matched full-clear and boundary-only libraries from one frozen C source with identical compiler flags except HMM_VITERBI_BOUNDARY_CLEAR_ONLY=1. Bind each library only inside this isolated benchmark process; do not overwrite installed or live-run extensions. Keep the existing full-clear default.
cohort: Use the same three QfO proteomes selected by SHA256 of filenames, but expand each query cohort to 512 hash-selected proteins against the full next proteome in cyclic order. Evaluate both FASTA and reversed order of the same query IDs. No reference labels or prior accuracy scores participate in query selection.
execution: Run the native search_species_pair_indexed entry point, including candidate prefilter/ranking, profile construction, Viterbi scoring, E-value calculation and normalized-score outputs. Warm both arms before four counterbalanced timed pairs per case. Require actual multipair-kernel invocation and prohibit silent CUDA/scalar/Numba fallback. Rebuild/search normally on each call; record timing scope as warmed species-pair search, not a cold process or full orthology pipeline.
validation: Require identical candidate counts, query/target index arrays, normalized scores and E-values across libraries for every call; require identical canonical gene-pair outputs across query orders. Verify query/target inputs, code, private libraries, compiler and scientific runtime before/after. Preserve partial failed reports; do not silently retry or reduce the cohort after a failure.
selection: Any output mismatch rejects advancement. Output equivalence plus directionally lower paired median search-stage CPU/wall cost is evidence for a later full-pipeline equivalence experiment, not default promotion. Record per-case tradeoffs and shared-host activity; do not substitute kernel ratios for pipeline measurements or add a new biological score vector.
limitations: Development-exposed QfO sequence cohort, not independent biological validation.
Only three proteomes and sampled queries, not all QfO searches or complete orthology inference.
